name: X-Man Tornado V4 M 3x3 (Pioneer UV)
description: The X-Man Tornado V4 M 3x3 (Pioneer UV) is the top-of-the-line QiYi 3x3 for 2024. This puzzle is a successor to the Tornado V3 which has set many world records over the last few years. This one has a ball-core, maglev tensioning system, and extra repelling magnets in the edges. (there are two repelling and one attracting magnet on each side of every edge!)
